landing.heroDesc: Monitor crop health with satellite imagery, detect anomalies early, and make data-driven decisions — all from a single, self-hostable platform.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to monitor your fields
landing.featuresSub: From satellite imagery to actionable reports — in one platform.
landing.feature1Desc: Automated NDVI analysis from Sentinel-2 imagery. Track crop health over time with zero hardware.
landing.feature2Desc: Draw field boundaries on the map, organize by farm, and track area, crop type, and season.
landing.feature3Desc: Get notified when vegetation indices drop. Add scouting notes with location and photos.
landing.feature4Desc: Generate read-only field health reports and share them with stakeholders via a single link.
landing.stepsSub: No hardware, no subscriptions — just your fields and a browser.
landing.step1Desc: Create a farm, then draw or upload field boundaries on the interactive map.
landing.step2Desc: We fetch the latest satellite imagery and compute vegetation indices for every field.
landing.step3Desc: View NDVI trends, spot anomalies early, and share reports with your team.
landing.ctaDesc: Sign in with Google to create your first farm and start tracking crop health with satellite data.
